observer_first_seen.description: Each observer has its own clock identity and UTC receive time.

CurveContext.description: Source, vantage point, regime and evaluation clock of a probability curve.

samples_needed.description: Additional fresh resolved samples; at least one when evidence is insufficient.

requested_economics.description: Preserves requested inputs even when stale/absent market evidence causes fallback.

ForecastLedgerExport.description: Phase 3 bounded forecast-only export; whole-chain verification is performed before pagination.
ForecastLedgerExport.title: ForecastLedgerExport

LatencyEstimate.description: Infinity/unidentifiable quantiles are null, never silently excluded failures.

LeaderSlot.description: A scheduled slot, distinct from a leader rotation. Slot identity is lossless decimal text.

ModelCovariates.description: Congestion is a dimensionless measured covariate; unknown is not zero.

ObserverGap.description: Gaps are distinct records; they never fabricate a signature or transaction outcome.

tip_lamports.description: Successful outer transfers are paid; inner transfers require execution evidence.

canaries.description: Ordered prospective members; no coincidentally matching records.

old_effective_n_cap.description: Full reset is an explicit zero cap on old-regime sample mass, not relabeling old outcomes.

TrainingCanary.description: Training eligibility includes finalization; provisional landings are not labels.

WorkbenchEvidence.description: Bounded read-only workbench evidence. A regime label is not a detected network change.
WorkbenchEvidence.title: WorkbenchEvidence

OperatorBearer.description: Server-side ALIGHT_OPERATOR_KEY. Never put it in a URL.

WebhookHmac.description: 64 hexadecimal characters: HMAC-SHA256 of exact body bytes using SOLAMI_WEBHOOK_SECRET
WebhookHmac.name: X-Webhook-Signature

info.description: Canary landing forecasts with explicit live/sim/replay evidence. Public reads never sign, send or persist forecasts.
info.title: Alight API

parameters.description: URL-encoded QuoteServiceRequest JSON; entire query at most 8192 bytes
parameters.name: request

get.description: Read-only source-scoped snapshots each second; 32 connections maximum, 1 MiB output cap, 4 KiB input cap, slow clients disconnect. Text/binary controls are rejected.

post.description: Live/observe only, default disabled. Exact body HMAC-SHA256 in X-Webhook-Signature (64 hex characters), 65536-byte cap, owned signatures only. Unknown identities/index scopes remain incomplete. Valid unowned deliveries are ignored.
